### Q2: prime planner (`src/prime.rs`) against the core

A request to start N stems on the next bar line (bar = 96,000 frames = 2 s at 120 bpm 4/4, 48 kHz) arrives `r` before a bar line. The planner (cost model: per stem `D` serial in the one worker, delivery tail 640 frames = 5 quanta, margin 25 %, L = 1,024) picks the earliest bar line it can prime for. Reading: `lead` is how long before T the B stream's OPEN and first chunk were committed in the ring. Anything committed before T's quantum starts gives a sample-exact seam (asserted: 0 frames wrong). ### Q3b: crossfade A -> B over X = 4,800 frames (100 ms), linear gains, B starting at T - X

A: FADE to 0 over X with stop-at-end, stamped T - X. B: PLAY gain 0 stamped T - X, SET_PARAMS gain 1 over X stamped T - X. Reference: A*(1-(k+1)/X) + B*((k+1)/X), k = t - (T - X). tol 1e-4: the core's ramp adds an f32 step per frame (`audio-dsp/src/ramp.rs:51-57`), so it drifts from the exact line by up to ~1e-5 here; a misaligned B is wrong by 0.1-0.5.
